hooks.command: exe="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/toolkit.exe"; if [ -n "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}" ] && [ -x "$exe" ]; then "$exe" session-start; elif command -v dart >/dev/null 2>&1; then dart "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/toolkit.dart" session-start; elif [ -f pubspec.yaml ]; then echo "flutter-agent-toolkit: 'dart' is not on PATH, so Flutter checks are off. Tell the user to add their Flutter SDK bin folder to PATH."; fi

exe="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/toolkit.exe"; if [ -n "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}" ] && [ -x "$exe" ]; then "$exe" post-edit; elif command -v dart >/dev/null 2>&1; then dart "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/toolkit.dart" post-edit; fi

exe="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/toolkit.exe"; if [ -n "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}" ] && [ -x "$exe" ]; then "$exe" stop; elif command -v dart >/dev/null 2>&1; then dart "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/toolkit.dart" stop; fi
hooks.statusMessage: Flutter toolkit: checking changed Dart files...
